name: 恋鐘
text: 摩美々～、ついでにこい捨てとくね～
trans:
Mamimi〜 I'm gonna go ahead n' toss this 
while we're cleanin' up〜!

name: 摩美々
text:
んー
お願いー
trans:
Hm?
Go for it.

name: 恋鐘
text:
あ、
こん包み紙、商店街のお弁当屋さんの～？
trans:
Oh, ain't this wrapping paper from that bento
place in the shopping district?

name: 恋鐘
text:
うちも気になっとったばい！
今月の月替わり弁当～！
trans:
I was wantin' to try 'em too! 
Especially that monthly special they've got!

name: 恋鐘
text:
小鮎とかたけのこごはん入っとって
ばりうまそうやったけど……どがんやった？
trans:
It's got little sweetfish and rice with bamboo
shoots, it looked so darn good! How was it?

name: 摩美々
text:
あー……
まぁ、普通に美味しかったぁ
trans:
Uhh...
Well, it was okay I guess.

name: 恋鐘
text:
ふぇ……
そんだけ？
trans:
Huh?
Just okay?

name: 摩美々
text: そんだけー
trans: Just okay.

name: 摩美々
text:
別に、私は前から気になってて
買ったとかじゃないしー
trans:
It's didn't buy it cause I was super
interested in it, though.

name: 恋鐘
text:
プロデューサー！
うん、もう支度はばっちりばい～！
trans:
Producer! 
Yep, we're ready and rarin' to go!

name: 恋鐘
text: ……ふぇ？

name: 恋鐘
text:
…………ん、わかったばい
摩美々にも伝えとくけん──
trans: ......Alrighty then, I'll let Mamimi know too──

name: 恋鐘
text: 次ん仕事、夕方からに変わったらしかよ
trans:
Looks like our next job isn't gonna start
til' evening now.

name: 恋鐘
text:
お迎えも遅くなるけん
時間潰しとって～って
trans:
Since we'll be getting picked up late,
he said we oughta find a way to pass the time!

name: 摩美々
text: えー…… マジー？
trans: Huh... for real?

name: 摩美々
text:
……まぁ
プロデューサーが来るまで待つしかないかぁ
trans:
...Well, guess we'll just have to wait for
Producer to get back, then.

name: 恋鐘
text: ん～～、そいもよかけど…………
trans: Mmm〜 We could do that, but...

name: 恋鐘
text: 今日はこがんよか天気ばい～？
trans: Ain't the weather sooo nice today?

name: 恋鐘
text:
うち、外に出ておてんとさま浴びて～
ぶらぶらしたか～
trans:
I wanna go outside and soak up the sun〜
Maybe go for a little stroll〜

name: 摩美々
text:
ふーん……
いってらっしゃいー
trans:
Hmm...
Have fun.

name: 恋鐘
text:
一緒に行かん？
事務所にこもっとったら、もったいなかけん～！
trans:
Wanna go together? It'd be a right shame 
to stay cooped up in the office like this〜!

name: 摩美々
text: えー……
trans: Ehh...

name: 恋鐘
text:
えーじゃなか、摩美々も行くばい～！
ずっとごろごろしとってもしょんなか！
trans:
Don't "ehh" me, you're coming too!
It's no good just lazin' around all the time!

name: 恋鐘
text:
ソファに根っこが生えてしまうばい～！
５月ば楽しまんば～！
trans:
You're growin' roots in that sofa〜!
Come enjoy May〜!

name: 恋鐘
text: ほら～！　ほらほら～！
trans: Come on〜! Come on, come on〜!

name: 摩美々
text: うー……
trans: Ugh...

name: 恋鐘
text: んん～、気持ちよか！
trans: Mmm〜 It feels so nice out!

name: 恋鐘
text:
風ん匂いもよかし、暑くも寒くもなかけん……
どこまででもいけそうな気分になるばい！
trans:
The breeze smells so good, and it ain't too hot or
cold... It feels like we could go anywhere!

name: 摩美々
text:
……恋鐘はどの季節でも
そのくらい元気だけどねー
trans:
...I think you're this energetic 
no matter what season it is.

name: 恋鐘
trans: Ah─

name: 摩美々
text:
ちょっと……
何ー？
trans:
Hey...
What is it?

name: 恋鐘
text:
ん～～～
風ん匂いが、甘か～ってなったけん……
trans:
Mmm〜
The smell on the breeze just got real sweet!

name: 恋鐘
text: ……摩美々、こっち来んね！
trans: ...Mamimi, c'mere!

name: 摩美々
text:
ちょっとー
だから……
trans:
Wait—
For what...

name: 恋鐘
text: 甘か匂い、バラの香りやったと～！
trans:
Looks like that sweetness I was smellin'
was these here roses〜!

name: 摩美々
text: ふーん……
trans: Hmm...

name: 摩美々
text: ……買うのー？
trans: Gonna buy them?

name: 恋鐘
text: うん～、迷っとると……
trans: Mmm〜 I'm not quite sure...

name: 恋鐘
text:
部屋の花瓶、
こん花束にはちょっと小さか気のして……
trans:
I'm worryin' the vase in my room might 
be a little too small for this bouquet...

name: 摩美々
text: あー……
trans: Ahh...

name: 摩美々
text:
まぁでも、
必ず花瓶に入れなきゃってわけでもないしー
trans:
Well I mean, it's not like you 
absolutely have to put it in that vase.

name: 恋鐘
text:
そうやね……！
決めた、こい買っていくばい！
trans:
Good point! My mind's made up, 
I'm gonna buy 'em!

name: 恋鐘
text: すみませ～ん……
trans: Excuse me〜!

name: 摩美々
text: ふふー、買っちゃったねー
trans: Haha, you really ended up buying them, huh.

name: 恋鐘
text:
んふふ～
事務所にもバラ飾るとよかかなって思ったけん……
trans:
Mhehe〜 I thought it might be nice decoratin'
the office with some flowers, too...

name: 恋鐘
text:
みんなが帰ってきた時に、
よか匂いしたら、嬉しか～ってなるやろ？
trans:
Don'tcha think everyone'll be real happy
if they come back to it smellin' all nice〜?

name: 摩美々
text: ふーん……
trans: Hmm...

name: 恋鐘
text: 摩美々には……こい！
trans: And for Mamimi... here!

name: 摩美々
text:
……え
何ー？
trans: ...Eh, what's this?

name: 恋鐘
text:
んふふ～
うちのお散歩、つきあってくれたお礼ばい！
trans:
Mhehe〜 As thanks for accompanying 
me on my walk!

name: 摩美々
text: あ、そうー
trans: Oh, yeah.

name: 摩美々
text:
……帰り際に
バラを一輪プレゼントとかぁ
trans:
...A single rose as a parting gift 
or something like that.

name: 恋鐘
text: ……ふぇ？

name: 摩美々
text: そっかー…………
trans: I see...

name: 摩美々
text: ……まぁ、もらっとくー
trans: ......Well, I'll take it.
